hypothesis_en: One conditional-template execution branch on the frozen native-contract parent. Qualify only the already approved generic marketing/category, short cookie-provider, and whole-document cookie framing/repetition conditions; then explicitly derive each task own verified-basis, delta, conflict and loss fields from the same retained propositions. A stock paragraph covered elsewhere does not become a separate processing rule beneath a generic heading, and a bare terms label supplies no unseen legal condition. Distinguish truthful asserted coverage from preferring the text that seems more accurate. Actual named items, operational routes, liability parties, changed processing/conditions and substantive body languages remain protected. Earlier prose-only clarifications left raw coverage explanations claiming an already covered stock paragraph or a provider/heading slot as a new loss. This trial adds qualification-to-field coupling without masking or rewriting source names, global slot normalization, policy consolidation, a new arbiter, source presentation, schema/enums, model, window, executor or validator changes. Retain the separately frozen native output-contract instructions and original padded packets.
hypothesis_zh: 在冻结的原生契约父版本上，仅增加一条有条件的模板执行分支。只确认既已允许的通用营销或分类、简短cookie服务商，以及全文cookie引言或重复条件，然后让每个任务从同一组保留命题明确推导自身的已验证依据、差异、冲突及损失字段。已在别处覆盖的通用段落不会因置于普通标题下就成为另一项处理规则，孤立的条款标签也不提供未呈现的法律条件。区分真实的断言覆盖与偏好看似更准确的文本。继续保护实际命名条目、操作入口、责任方、处理或条件变化及实质正文语言。此前仅以文字澄清，仍留下将已覆盖段落或服务商或标题槽位视为新损失的原始coverage解释。本次增加条件确认到字段推导的关联，不遮蔽或改写来源名称，不进行通用槽位归一化、政策合并，也不增加仲裁器，不改变来源呈现、结构或枚举、模型、窗口、执行器或校验。保留已单独冻结的原生输出契约指令及原有填充证据包。
